scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && cd backend && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
